描述_EN: made around 1410, its closest analogy in terms of technique and decoration is with a rare group of lacquered wooden covers for tibetan buddhist scriptures. the red lacquer has been decorated in the qiang jin (incised gold) technique, whereby the pattern is incised with a sharp point, and subsequently filled with gold leaf. it once had removable extension legs. this low, lacquer table is unique since it is the only piece of furniture that can be associated with any conviction to a lacquer workshop producing items to imperial commission prior to the move of china's capital to beijing in 1423. a variety of uses has been suggested for this table.
描述_ZN: 1410年左右制作的，在技术和装饰方面最接近的是一组罕见的西藏佛教经书的漆器木套。 红漆被装饰在qiang jin（刻金）技术中，即用尖头刻出图案，然后用金箔填充。 它曾经有可移动的延伸腿。 这个低矮的漆桌是独一无二的，因为它是唯一一件可以与1423年中国迁都北京之前的漆器作坊有关的家具，该作坊为皇室提供物品。 这个桌子有多种用途。
